entries.what: Slept in until 9, then made coffee and went over the secondhand study guide's tabbed chapters at the Verdant Commons kitchen table before driving to Ruel Road.

entries.what: Studied in the morning with the practice-test app, scoring in the low 70s again.

entries.outcome: Picker back on rate within minutes.

entries.outcome: Roaming issues traced to one access point.

entries.what: Quick walk through Verdant Commons with Iris after shift, then straight to bed.
Late morning at home with the car repair sorted since last week; filled up at the Ruel Road station before work.
Thursday training with Bao on scanner repairs from 3 to 5, then a pile of badge reader tickets.
entries.outcome: Badge readers fixed, Bao logged his first RMA.

entries.what: Thursday sushi night: Iris ordered as usual and they ate on the couch watching a show on their shared streaming account.
Morning of practice questions and a half-hour of subnetting flashcards.
Swing shift at RF-4; picked up Taquería Colima for her shift meal on Friday as usual.
entries.outcome: Ate in the break room next to the IT cage.

entries.what: A busy Friday night with several frozen handhelds; she rebooted and replaced them at the cage.
entries.outcome: No one fell badly behind rate.

entries.what: Walked the Ulloa marsh boardwalk in the morning with a coffee.
Went to her parents' fourplex off Vinca to fix the printer and update their phones.
Afternoon study session with the practice app and a long block of port numbers.
Slow Sunday morning; Iris and Noemi went to the Delgado Park harvest farmers market for peppers and stone fruit.

Sunday night co-op survival game with her online squad.
